code: library(fmriAR) set.seed(2024)  TR <- 2 n_per_run <- 150 runs <- rep(1:2, each = n_per_run)   # a run label for every volume n_time <- length(runs)  # Brief events 12-20 s apart, convolved with a canonical HRF hrf <- function(t) dgamma(t, 6) - dgamma(t, 16) / 6 h <- hrf(seq(0, 30, by = TR)) event_regressor <- function(n) {   onsets <- cumsum(sample(6:10, n, replace = TRUE))   stim <- tabulate(onsets[onsets <= n], nbins = n)   x <- stats::filter(stim, h / max(h), sides = 1)   as.numeric(replace(x, is.na(x), 0)) }  # Three slow cosines per run absorb scanner drift cosines <- function(n, k) {   sapply(seq_len(k), function(j) cos(pi * j * (seq_len(n) - 0.5) / n)) } none <- matrix(0, n_per_run, 3)  X <- cbind(c(event_regressor(n_per_run), event_regressor(n_per_run)),            runs == 1, runs == 2,            rbind(cosines(n_per_run, 3), none),            rbind(none, cosines(n_per_run, 3))) colnames(X) <- c("task", "run1", "run2", paste0("drift", 1:6)) n_vox <- 10000 active <- 1:1000 null <- setdiff(seq_len(n_vox), active)  ar1_run <- function() as.numeric(arima.sim(list(ar = 0.5), n = n_per_run)) noise <- replicate(n_vox, c(ar1_run(), ar1_run()))  beta <- ifelse(seq_len(n_vox) %in% active, 0.5, 0) Y <- noise + outer(X[, "task"], beta)
